works.body: I would like a humanoid form of the Bound Dock from Z Gundam, please! If possible, I would appreciate it if you could use black as a base color and white as well, to give it a monochrome look. I would be very happy if you could make it look monochrome. If you can change the color of the eyes, I would like them to be blue! Thank you very much!

Hello, Demon King Half Horseman. Thank you very much for finding me and appealing to me.
I would like to draw an outsider" and "I am good at drawing people in armor," so I will start requesting outsiders from my home that I can think of.

I would like to request the character "Chariot (reverse position form)" from my tarot creation.


[Character Features.
A half-human, half-horse (centaur type), non-human, as if wearing a mask and armor. The character is described as "wearing a mask," but his face does not exist and the screen is empty.

I hope you can imagine "a figure like a horse running out of control" since it is an out of person who imagined the meaning of the reverse position
Main interpretations of chariot (reverse): spinning out of control, runaway, withdrawal, impatience, temper, frustration, etc...


[Desired composition and background
If possible, I would like to see the tank with its front legs raised, as if to say it is about to run out of control with a whinny. If it is difficult, you may put them down.
If possible, the background should be a wilderness and an old castle standing in the distance. If it is difficult, you can make it completely white.


Since the character is half man and half horse, you may cancel the request if it is too difficult. I hope that my non-human character can be food for expression for Mr. Demon King Half Horse.
Thank you very much.
